defects: Adds hypothesis hg_cont : Continuous g, which is not present in the gold statement (gold holds for arbitrary g with no regularity assumption)
Adds hypothesis hg_int : IntegrableOn (fun x => (g ∘ log) x * x⁻¹) (Ici a), which is not present in the gold statement (gold is an unconditional identity)

Restricts g to ℝ → ℝ instead of the general codomain g : ℝ → E for an arbitrary normed space E, losing generality (and correspondingly uses ordinary multiplication x⁻¹ * g(log x) instead of the scalar action x⁻¹ • g(log x))
